ceu: ✦ The trine between Venus and Pluto

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.

The trine between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, relationships and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Move your body first thing in the morning, even if it is only a ten-minute walk.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.

The trine between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, routine and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Help someone quietly, without them knowing it was you.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.

The trine between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, romance and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Share a project of yours with someone who can help.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.

The trine between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, family and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Ask for an honest opinion from someone you respect.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.

The trine between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, conversations and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Write down where you want to be a year from now.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.

The trine between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, money and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: End the day with a minute of gratitude for what has changed in you.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.

The trine between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your image and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to your partner or to a close friend.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.

The trine between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your inner life and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Swap a snack for fruit and notice how you feel.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.

The trine between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, friendships and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Dance at home, even if it is just to one song.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.

The trine between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your career and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Open the windows in the morning and let fresh air into your home.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.

The trine between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your horizons and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Before reacting to a message, read it twice.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.

The trine between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Think of a way to make one of your talents pay off.
